annotations.title: Public holidays by country: list a country's public holidays for a year

description: Public holidays for a year in over 100 countries: date, local and English name, whether it is nationwide, and the observed day where a weekend moves it. Statutory rules of our own for the US, UK, Sweden, Germany, France, Norway, Denmark and Finland (2024-2100); Nager.Date for the rest (Japan, Canada, Australia, India, Brazil…). Use for scheduling, delivery dates and business-day maths. Example: country=SE. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
